title: MBA & business schools
summary: For working professionals: entrepreneurship, finance, management and the Chinese market.
overview: Chinese business schools increasingly appear in international rankings and focus on practice: local company cases, networking and projects with real clients. English-taught MBAs cluster in Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen.

An MBA isn't a program from zero. Most expect 2–3 years of work experience, a bachelor's degree, a CV, essays and references. Cost varies widely by school, so compare cohort, career service and format, not just price.
fitFor: You have 2+ years of work experience
You want a career in China or with Chinese partners
You're interested in finance, entrepreneurship or supply chain
You're ready to invest in network and school brand
outcomes: An MBA or management master's degree
A portfolio of cases and projects
A working understanding of the Chinese market

timeline.text: We compare schools by career track, accreditation and cohort profile.
We prepare the CV, essays, references and GMAT/GRE if required.
Round-based applications, interviews and sometimes group exercises.

faq.question: Can I get into an MBA without GMAT?
faq.answer: Many Chinese business schools accept candidates without GMAT, especially with strong work experience, but requirements vary. Some use an internal test or assess experience instead.

faq.question: How much does an MBA in China cost?
faq.answer: The range is wide: from tens of thousands of yuan at regional schools to significantly more at top business schools. We verify tuition and scholarships for the specific school and intake year.
